settings.title: Give customers one calm place to check what happens after checkout.
settings.body: If you are using a dedicated order-tracking app, embed it on this page. If not, use the structure below so customers know exactly what information to prepare before contacting support.

settings.title: Check your order confirmation email first
settings.body: Customers should keep their order number, checkout email and shipping name ready before asking for manual help.

settings.title: Allow the processing window promised at checkout
settings.body: Set clear expectations for dispatch timing and repeat them in confirmation emails so tracking questions arrive with better context.

settings.title: Escalate exceptions through support with exact details
settings.body: When something is delayed or unclear, route the customer to support with a short checklist instead of generic policy copy.

settings.title: Tracking works best when the customer knows what to expect at each stage.
settings.body: Use this page as the home for your future tracking app or as a support-first fallback while operations are still being finalized.
